author: gsFALCON
quote: Visually, the game looks impressive, and the updated map, minimap, and menus are great improvements. However, everything else falls completely flat.Performance is unacceptable, struggling at around 23 FPS, which makes the experience frustrating to play. The writing feels overly sanitized, leaning heavily into woke themes, forced feminism, and a toned-down, non-violent approach that ruins the classic GTA identity. PS: Despite the visual upgrades, it clearly runs on the same RDR2 engine rather than evolving from GTA 5, making the gameplay feel sluggish instead of snappy.
